MERCHANT CARD RECONCILIATION – STEP BY STEP GUIDE

Use this guide to review and complete Merchant Card / POS reconciliation in ODOO. Follow each step in sequence and verify the supporting evidence before completion.

ⓘ Merchant Card Reconciliation Review
1Find the merchant transaction email2Save the merchant file3Create the accounting entry in ODOO4Open the relevant POS payment receipts5Match the card transaction reference6Determine whether the transaction belongs to RRE or the Landlord7Complete the reconciliation
💳POS / CREDIT CARD RECONCILIATION
1
Find the merchant transaction email
Go to email and search for the subject: Merchant Card Transaction NI Merchant HD.
2
Save the merchant file
Save the file in:
Accounts Drive›Merchant Card Transaction›RRE›2026
3
Create the accounting entry in ODOO
ODOO Navigation: Accounting > Filter: Type POS (Journal) > Create New
FieldWhat to Enter
DateUse the email date.
LabelMerchant Card Transaction
AmountUse the Net Payable / Receivable amount.
After entering the details, select Save and Close.
Photo 1 — ODOO Accounting Dashboard: POS Merchant Card journal
Photo 2 — ODOO POS Merchant Card: New Transaction entry
4
Open the relevant POS payment receipts
ODOO Navigation: Contracts > Payment Receipts
FilterSelection
Receipt DateSelect the required day using From and To.
Custom Group / FilterHas Card Payment = Yes
ODOO Payment Receipts — Receipt Date filter with Has Card Payment = Yes
5
Match the card transaction reference
Use the POS slip and the ODOO receipt line together. Match the Approval Code / Auth Code shown on the card slip to the Transaction Reference recorded in ODOO. Also confirm that the amount, payment method and collected date agree.
iApproval Code / Auth Code = ODOO Transaction Reference
Photo 1 — ODOO Payment Receipt: locate the attached POS slip and the payment line transaction reference.
Photo 2 — POS slip: verify the approved amount and the Approval Code / Auth Code.
Photo 3 — ODOO Receipt Lines: confirm Transaction Reference, Card payment method, collected amount and collected date.
6
Determine whether the transaction belongs to RRE or the Landlord
For all POS / card transactions, the following ODOO fields must always be assigned to RRE, including when the payment category is Rent:
ODOO FieldRequired POS Value
ReceiverRRE
Deposit ToRRE
Bank AccountRRE
Important: Do not change Receiver, Deposit To or Bank Account to the Landlord for a POS transaction. These three fields remain RRE even when the POS payment is for Rent.
Special rule — Shaikha Fatma: there should be no RENT POS payment. POS payments should only relate to Municipality.
If a RENT payment for Shaikha Fatma was collected via POS: inform the Supervisor first, then proceed with the normal POS process.
Photo 4 — After all POS details are verified, click Submit Payment(s).
Photo 5 — In the Submit Payments window, verify the line and click Confirm.
7
Complete the reconciliation
✓ Merchant transaction appears in the email/file
✓ Net Payable / Receivable matches the accounting entry
✓ Approval Code / Auth Code matches the ODOO Transaction Reference
✓ Receipt date falls within the selected day
✓ Receiver, Deposit To and Bank Account are all RRE for every POS transaction
✓ Shaikha Fatma rule has been checked where applicable
